content: ## Gameplan Play lots of elves and then swing [[Craterhoof Behemoth]] or [[Finale of Devastation]]. ## Gameplay videos Here's a list of videos featuring Lathril: **[Watch Lathril, Blade of the Elves gameplay videos](https://watchedh.com/commanders/lathril-blade-of-the-elves/)**. ## Combos List all combos of the deck with [EDH Decklist Combo Finder](https://combo-finder.com/) or find new commander combos with [EDH Combo Search Engine](https://edh-combos.com/). ## Card recommendations & similar Commanders Have a look at [Lathril on EDH.Wiki](https://edh.wiki/commanders/lathril-blade-of-the-elves/) to get some great card recommendations or find similar commanders. ## Tools Lotus, a web-based life counter app supporting Commander damage, up to 10 players, customizable player backgrounds via Scryfall, and Monarch tracking: **[Lotus: MTG Life Counter](https://lifecounter.app)**
